en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from a man, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘The vibrant-coloured (clothing) is disliked except for the wedding’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Wearing clothes of sharp color is not desirable except for weddings/”
